# MDL014: mdl-vmodel

A V-model construction error.

Wrong endpoint kinds, unpaired levels on `verifies`, a missing `ref` or `runnable`, a duplicate link, or `supersedes` without `because`.

## Examples

### MDL014 V-model construction / A test vmodel without runnable fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
vmodel req {
  kind artifact;
  level requirements;
  ref "docs/design/a.md#req";
}
vmodel t_missing {
  kind test;
  level customer_test;
  verifies req;
}
```

### MDL014 V-model construction / A paired verifies is clean #2 (line 23) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
vmodel req {
  kind artifact;
  level requirements;
  ref "docs/design/a.md#req";
}
vmodel t_ok {
  kind test;
  level customer_test;
  runnable "t.rs::ok";
  verifies req;
}
```
